# API reference

Generated from the source of `github.com/otfabric/go-profinet` with `docsync api`; the doc comments are the documentation. The guides around it explain how the pieces fit.

| Package | Synopsis |
|---|---|
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet](go-profinet.md) |  |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/alarm](alarm.md) | Package alarm implements the acyclic real-time transport of PROFINET alarms (RTA, IEC 61158-6-10): the codec of RTA PDUs and the alarm protocol machines of one AR — a sender (APMS) and a receiver (APMR) per priority, with sequence numbers, acknowledgement, retransmission and the ERR PDU that aborts an AR. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/controller](controller.md) | Package controller implements a PROFINET IO-Controller (conformance class A, RT_CLASS_1/2): it finds its devices by station name with DCP, optionally assigns their IP address, establishes an application relationship with each, parameterizes it, exchanges cyclic IO data, acknowledges alarms, reads and writes records and re-establishes the AR after a failure. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/dcp](dcp.md) | Package dcp implements the PROFINET Discovery and basic Configuration Protocol (IEC 61158-6-10): the codec of DCP frames and blocks, a requester (Identify, Get, Set, Hello) and a responder for IO-Devices. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/device](device.md) | Package device implements a PROFINET IO-Device (conformance class A, RT_CLASS_1/2): the DCP responder, the RPC server for Connect, Read, Write, Control and Release, application relationships with their explicit state machine, cyclic input production and output consumption, alarms, diagnosis and identification and maintenance records. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/ethernet](ethernet.md) | Package ethernet encodes and decodes Ethernet II frames with an optional IEEE 802.1Q tag: the layer every PROFINET frame (DCP, LLDP, RT, alarms) travels on. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/gsdml](gsdml.md) | Package gsdml reads, validates and writes GSDML (General Station Description Markup Language) files, the XML device descriptions of PROFINET IO devices, and converts between them and the device models of package model. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/gsdml/gsdx](gsdml-gsdx.md) | Package gsdx inspects GSDX containers: Open Packaging Conventions (OPC) packages, ISO/IEC 29500-2 / Ecma-376 Part 2, which are public. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2](l2.md) | Package l2 defines the Layer 2 port abstraction PROFINET runs on and a demultiplexer that shares one port between the protocol engines (DCP, LLDP, cyclic RT, alarms, the IP stack of a virtual network). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/afpacket](l2-afpacket.md) | Package afpacket is the Linux backend of l2.Port: a raw AF_PACKET socket bound to one network interface. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/bpf](l2-bpf.md) | Package bpf is the macOS, FreeBSD, NetBSD and DragonFly backend of l2.Port: a Berkeley Packet Filter device (/dev/bpf*) attached to one network interface. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/bridge](l2-bridge.md) | Package bridge is the switch of a multiport device: a learning Ethernet bridge between its physical ports, with the device's interface attached as one more port (the "CPU port"). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/npcap](l2-npcap.md) | Package npcap is the Windows backend of l2.Port, on the Npcap driver (https://npcap.com), which must be installed separately (its licence does not allow redistributing it). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/osport](l2-osport.md) | Package osport opens an l2.Port on a network interface with the backend of the operating system: AF_PACKET on Linux (package l2/afpacket), BPF on macOS and the BSDs (package l2/bpf) and Npcap on Windows (package l2/npcap). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/lldp](lldp.md) | Package lldp implements the Link Layer Discovery Protocol (IEEE 802.1AB) with the organizationally specific TLVs PROFINET uses (IEC 61158-6-10: OUI 00-0E-CF) and the IEEE 802.3 MAC/PHY TLV: the frame codec, and an agent that announces the local port and keeps a table of neighbors with expiry. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/model](model.md) | Package model describes a PROFINET IO device in Go: its identity, the device access point, the modules plugged into its slots and the submodules with their IO data and parameter records. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/mrp](mrp.md) | Package mrp encodes and decodes the frames of the Media Redundancy Protocol (IEC 62439-2) that PROFINET rings use: MRP_Test, MRP_TopologyChange, MRP_LinkDown and MRP_LinkUp with MRP_Common and MRP_Option. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/netstack](netstack.md) | Package netstack is a minimal IPv4 stack (ARP, IPv4 without fragments, UDP) on an l2.Mux. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/pcap](pcap.md) | Package pcap writes and reads capture files in the classic libpcap format with the Ethernet link type, so that traffic of the virtual network (and of the real backends) can be inspected with Wireshark or tshark. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/pnio](pnio.md) | Package pnio encodes and decodes the PROFINET IO application layer (IEC 61158-6-10): the blocks of the connect, control, release, read and write services, the NDR argument headers they travel in over RPC, the PNIO status, identification and maintenance records, diagnosis data, alarm notifications and identification data. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/ptcp](ptcp.md) | Package ptcp encodes and decodes the delay frames of the Precision Transparent Clock Protocol (PTCP, IEC 61158-6-10): DelayReq and the delay responses with which neighbors measure the line delay of a link. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/rpc](rpc.md) | Package rpc implements the connectionless DCE RPC protocol (DCE 1.1 RPC, chapter 12, "CL") that PROFINET IO uses for its acyclic services over UDP: the packet header, fragmentation and reassembly, a client with retransmission and an at-most-once server with a response cache. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/rt](rt.md) | Package rt implements cyclic real-time PROFINET IO (RT_CLASS_1/2, unsynchronized): the codec of cyclic frames, the layout of the IO data in a frame, providers and consumers with their watchdog, and the scheduler that drives them. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/snmp](snmp.md) | Package snmp implements a read-only SNMPv1/SNMPv2c agent (RFC 1157, RFC 1901, RFC 3416) with the BER codec of its messages (RFC 3417) and helpers for the MIB modules a PROFINET device of conformance class B offers: the system, interfaces and snmp groups of MIB-II (RFC 1213, RFC 3418, RFC 2863) and the LLDP-MIB of IEEE 802.1AB-2005. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/store](store.md) | Package store is the optional persistence of go-profinet: the values a device must keep across a restart (its permanent station name and IP suite, its I&M records) are saved in a Store under a key. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/vnet](vnet.md) | Package vnet is an in-memory Ethernet network: a switch with any number of endpoints, each an [l2.Port] with its own MAC address, that carries serialized Ethernet frames between them. |
